depiction.primary_object: vertical double-headed arrow between two horizontal parallel bars

readings.meaning: vertical expand, stretch, or fit to height

ambiguity: Can be confused with UI layout controls (expand vertically, line height, row height) or an elevator/up-down control rather than a real-world object.
task_intents: measure height of furniture or space
record child height on growth chart
adjust desk or monitor stand height
set row height or line spacing

Set the tripod and ring light level for the seated interview shots

reasoning: The icon is a standard UI/diagrammatic symbol for vertical dimension, height, or expand-to-height (a vertical double arrow bounded by two horizontal bars). In a to-do list, height is almost always an attribute or measurement of a concrete object (a fridge, curtains, a desk, a child, a CSS box) rather than the subject itself, and a tape measure or ruler icon serves general measuring tasks much better.
